title: St. Petersburg drone attack — Russia's SPIEF economic theater vs. kinetic reality — June 6 2026
narrative: On June 5-6, 2026, Ukraine launched what Russia called an "unprecedented" mass drone attack on St. Petersburg, targeting Russian military facilities including a navy base. The attack came on the final day of the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF) — dubbed "Putin's Davos" — where Russia projected economic confidence and international relevance. Putin had just rejected Zelenskyy's offer for direct peace talks. Russia's Defense Ministry claimed "hundreds" of drones were downed. Official SPIEF messaging continued projecting business-as-usual.

analysis:
Official sources say one thing. The evidence says another.

St. Petersburg under drone attack while Putin hosts an economic forum is the perfect elite-vs-reality split screen. OSINT verification:
1. Geolocate explosion videos from St. Petersburg — cross-reference with satellite imagery of the navy base
2. FlightRadar24: airspace closure data over St. Petersburg — contradicts SPIEF "business as usual" messaging
3. FIR/MSI notices: did Russia issue NOTAMs closing St. Petersburg airspace during the forum?
4. Compare Russian MoD's "all drones downed" claim vs. visually-confirmed impact sites
5. Social media geolocation: citizen videos showing explosions, smoke plumes
Headline angle: "The Forum and the Fire: How Drones Crashed Putin's Economic Theater"
